title: auth: dummy bcrypt hash uses DEFAULT_COST, may not match production cost
description:
## Problem
auth/src/store.rs line ~21 computes a dummy bcrypt hash at a hardcoded DEFAULT_COST to avoid a timing oracle when a username is not found. If the operator's real password hashes were generated at a different cost (e.g. cost=12 while DEFAULT_COST=10), the dummy verify takes noticeably less time than a real failed verify, leaking whether a username exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- The dummy hash cost must be configurable to match the production bcrypt cost, OR
- Use a pre-computed lazy_static dummy hash at the same cost as configured auth
- Verify that the timing delta between 'user not found' and 'user found, wrong password' is ≤1ms on 1000-sample benchmark
